description: Brian’s status as the last single friend becomes harder to treat as a joke when attraction, engagements and changing loyalties begin destabilising the group around him.

s01e01.description: Brian and his friends navigate the relationship fallout at the center of “Pilot”, as romantic expectations, friendship and loyalty collide in inconvenient combinations.
